title: Quota, Routing & Auth — tactics sprint snapshot
content:
Sprint snapshot for the weekly platform tactics hour (focus: control plane routing, auth, and quotas). This is a working note — half polish, half scratchpad. Last updated after triage call on 2026-10-22.

Attendees: Asha (owner), Liam, Maya, Noah, Elena, Priya (oncall handover), Tom (SRE cameo).

1) Quick summary / purpose
- Short-term goal: stabilize quota enforcement latency regressions introduced by the continuous-batch change set; ensure routing fallback policy does not amplify tail latency; unblock INF-4823 automated quota reconciliation rollout.
- Mid-term goal: reduce quota enforcement p99 from ~310ms to <180ms for hosted-API control plane calls, while keeping route selection cost under 40ms.

2) Decisions made
- Pause the multi-tenant prefix cache patch in the control plane until we validate KV eviction under heavy routing churn (PR #2123). Action: Liam to add microbench with churn pattern by EOD 2026-10-23.
- Route fallback policy: adopt staged percentage-based fallback (5% shadow -> 25% canary -> 100% fallback) for cross-region failures, with metric gating on error-rate and latency. Maya to draft policy config (yaml) and submit to infra-configs repo.

3) Blockers / open risks
- INF-4910: quota-delta race condition when tenant metadata update coincides with quota reconciliation job; replication lag causes transient under-enforcement. Risk: high for Dedicated customers. Mitigation: run reconciliation scanner with tombstone window + safety net (deny-by-default) if reconciliation results are inconsistent. Noah to prototype safety net switch.
- Observability gap: quota enforcement path lacks per-tenant trace IDs in the control plane logs. Correlating enforcement latency with specific routing decisions is hard. Elena to open instrument ticket and attach sample spans from tonight's oncall replay.

4) Action items (owners + due dates)
- Liam: add microbench for multi-tenant KV churn + post results to #platform-bench by 2026-10-23. (blocking PR #2123 pause).
- Maya: config PR for staged fallback routing (yaml + gating rules) by 2026-10-26; include smoke test plan.
- Noah: prototype reconciliation safety-net (deny-by-default switch) and deploy to staging 2026-10-24.
- Elena: add per-tenant trace-id instrumentation for quota path; create unit/integration tests and doc how to use traces by 2026-10-29.
- Asha: coordinate customer-impact comms for Dedicated tenants (if INF-4910 reproduces), draft optional migration steps. Draft due 2026-10-25.

5) Notes from subteams (raw, often shorthand)
- Control plane (Liam):
  * Observed: p95 enforcement latency stable; p99 regressed after async batching change. Likely culprit: lock contention + serialization in reconcile fast-path.
  * Temp fix: revert batching patch for tenants with >8k daily calls (very small subset) to eval impact.
  * TODO: collect flamegraphs from staging drive.

- Routing (Maya):
  * Work on more graceful region-fallback; current immediate failover creates short traffic spikes to fallback pool (thundering herd). Proposed smoothing with token-bucket ramp (5% increments per minute) + slow-start per-client session.
  * Need to coordinate with quota changes — fallback increases per-host load which can trigger quota storms.

- Auth (Noah):
  * Reconcile job ordering updated to be idempotent but not atomic; race when metadata update in-flight. Working on op-log ordering with vector timestamps; exploring simpler short-term fix (lease during reconciliation window).
  * P0: ensure dedicated customers do not see enforcement holes.

- Quotas (Elena):
  * Added counters for reconciliation-run duration; observed two long-running runs last night correlated with a region restart. Investigating root cause.
  * Want to introduce a reconciliation backoff and staggered window to avoid global sweeps after infra restarts.

6) Metrics snapshot (from the morning dashboards)
- Quota enforcement latencies (control plane): p50=34ms, p95=142ms, p99=308ms (baseline last week p99=168ms).
- Route selection cost: p50=12ms, p95=35ms, p99=78ms.
- Reconciliation job duration (median): 2.4s, 95th: 48s (outliers during region restart).
- Error-rate for route-fallback events: 0.03% global, spikes to 1.4% for region eu-west-1 during restart window.

7) Quick experiments / runbook suggestions
- Small experiment: enable per-tenant quota caching TTL of 250ms for high-QPS tenants only; monitor reconciliation divergence. Fast rollback toggle required.
- Add a canary route pool in one AZ rather than region-wide to reduce blast-radius when fallback policy engages.

8) Meeting log (timestamps, raw)
- 09:03: quick sync; Liam shares flamegraph hypothesis.
- 09:12: Maya demoed fallback ramp yaml snippet. Feedback: add circuit-breaker thresholds per-customer-tier.
- 09:25: Noah walks through INF-4910 repro steps; reproduced in staging with delayed metadata propagation.
- 09:37: Elena shows reconciliation duration chart; proposed stagger windows.
- 09:45: agreed action list and owners.

9) Unresolved questions / follow-ups
- What is the acceptable p99 SLO change for dedicated tenants during migration windows? Ops to define SLAs for maintenance windows.
- Can we safely apply per-tenant short leases without impacting control plane scale? Need capacity modeling.

10) References / quick links
- JIRA INF-4823: quota reconciliation redesign (owner: Noah)
- JIRA INF-4910: quota-delta race (owner: Noah)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2123 (multi-tenant prefix cache change)
- Confluence: PLTFM-Quota-Playbook (instrumentation & runbooks)

Next meeting: follow-up tactics hour 2026-10-28 09:00 PT. Please update your action items in the ticket before EOD 2026-10-24.

Notes-to-self (Asha): remind SRE to attach the oncall replay for 2026-10-20; that trace has the largest p99 spike and will help root cause.

Scratch area (do not finalize):
- Quick grep results: churn pattern appears when tenant-shard remap + routing table rebuild coincide. Could be transient due to shard-resize job overlapping; check allocator logs.
- Potential follow-up: small hack — snapshot tenant-quota into a local memcache during heavy routing rebuilds to avoid hitting central KV. Needs safety analysis.

End of doc.
